root_causes.description: Cart service shows a sharp p99 latency spike (~72ms, p50 ~3ms) during the incident window while all peer leaf services remained at ~2-10ms. No error-rate increase, CPU/memory pressure, or pod crashes were observed, indicating an injected latency fault localized to cart.

evidence.observed_value: p99=72.157ms, max=74.424ms, mean=19.994ms (p50=3.11ms) with anomaly detected
cart 'order-consumed' span at 23674ms; search_traces service_name=cart min_duration_ms=50 returned 16 traces, p95_duration=3160787ms, 0 errors
evidence.expected_baseline: cart server spans normally single-digit ms; no errors expected

evidence.observed_value: cart pod container started 3x; no OOMKilled/BackOff/FailedMount events
evidence.expected_baseline: stable single running container with no unexpected restarts/crashes

root_causes.description: Checkout p99 (~48ms) is elevated relative to leaf services, but this is attributable to it calling the slow cart service downstream rather than an intrinsic checkout fault.
Frontend p99 (~47.76ms) is mildly elevated, consistent with propagating upstream latency from checkout/cart rather than a frontend-local fault; error rate remained 0.

remediation_steps: Inspect cart service for injected latency (e.g., flagd feature flag / chaos latency injection targeting cart) and disable the fault flag.
Verify cart application-level processing time and any downstream/store calls for added delays; compare cart span durations against historical baseline.
Monitor cart p99 latency after remediation to confirm return to ~2-3ms and ensure upstream checkout/frontend latency normalizes.
Add alerting on per-service p99 latency deviations to catch localized latency injections earlier.
